So the content is correct; the as-written MAIN item carries the wrong (OCR-corrupted) formula 1-d/k and therefore stays pending until replaced by the corrected-v2 item in batch3_apps_repairs.json (reviewed accept). The underlying math is not wrong -- it is a source-linearization typo, now repaired.
